text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, that takes care of the shrine 
visit.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I haven't been feeling so great 
lately, so I hope some of that divine 
blessing rubs off on me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: CHECKMAAAATE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what was that voice just now? It 
sounded pretty familiar."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Shogi Master
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's a bishop. Not a lance... which 
means, checkmate!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh!! I went and did it again—!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The old guy from the stationery shop and 
Bakushin O-san... how are they doing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I yield! To think you could defeat an 
honor student like me! You must be a 
remarkably famous honor student yourself!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Shogi Master
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Like I'd remember something from 
half a century ago! Besides, you're pretty 
darn skilled yourself, Nei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!? I'd love to see that! Nature-san, 
please show us one match!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! I only played a tiny bit against 
customers at my family's shop when I was 
little!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides, dragging you along with me, 
Trainer...
choice_data_list: That should be a nice morale boost.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~... Big words, Trainer. ...Well, now 
that you've said that, I can't go losing, 
can I?
And so, the battle upon the board began—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Mmm... feels like endgame in two moves. 
It all depends on whether I sacrifice this 
piece or not...)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yes, checkmate~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Shogi Master
text_block_list.text: Ah! You got me!! You're tough, Ne-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A brilliant move!! Splendid!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
When you put it so bluntly... I kind of 
don't know how to react, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, next time you'll face me!! I 
will make my comeback without fail!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No, you said just one match—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Jeez, really. You sure are a smooth 
talker.

Even after that, Nice Nature breezed her 
way to victory in great form!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I surrender!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Shogi Master
text_block_list.text:
Gwahaha~! Your endgame was too weak~! Your 
moves were hesitant, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"My head just feels so fuzzy. ...Guess I 
won't bounce back that easily, huh~."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san! When in doubt... all you have 
to do is BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Sorry, what was that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, we use the Lance to bakushin 
across the board!! Bakushin!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, yeah... that's true. Maybe it's 
better to just be decisive... instead of 
mulling over it endlessly?"

Afterward, we played another match for 
revenge, but... I was helplessly struck 
down by the Bishop.
